1. A global signed-channel construction

Let $\Phi_T$ denote the actual propagator of the supplied scheduled generator. Fix any finite cap $\eta_{\max}$ on the perturbations; the following result does not require unitality or a supplied invariant state.

Assign each local Hamiltonian or dissipative term to one site in its support. Group the terms assigned to site $i$, together with its native replacement term, into a GKLS generator $\mathcal A_i(t)$. Use a fixed declared support $B_i$ throughout the schedule, padded to cover every term assigned to that anchor.

We can take

$$s=(2\lceil a\rceil+1)^2,\qquad h=s,$$

where $|B_i|\le s$ and at most $h$ declared balls cover any site. A sufficient bound is

$$\|\mathcal A_i(t)\|_\diamond\le \nu,
\qquad
\nu=2dJ+2\gamma+d\gamma\eta_{\max}.$$

Theorem: a rational global approximation at short time

Suppose

$$\boxed{\nu T\le \frac{1}{12sh}.}
\tag{1}$$

Equivalently, with $\tau=\gamma T$,

$$\tau\le
\frac{1}{12sh(2dg+2+d\eta_{\max})}.$$

For every rational $0<\xi\le1$, a deterministic compiler produces a polynomial-size list of rational local superoperators $\widehat{\mathcal K}_X$, supported on sets of size at most

$$L=\min\!\left\{
n,\;
s\left\lceil\log_4\frac{16n}{\xi}\right\rceil
\right\}.
\tag{2}$$

The list defines one signed channel:

$$\widehat{\mathcal Q}_L
=
\sum_{\substack{\mathcal F\text{ pairwise disjoint}\\
|X|\le L\;\forall X\in\mathcal F}}
\left(\bigotimes_{X\in\mathcal F}\widehat{\mathcal K}_X\right)
\otimes
\operatorname{Id}_{V\setminus\cup\mathcal F}.
\tag{3}$$

It satisfies

$$\boxed{
\|\widehat{\mathcal Q}_L-\Phi_T\|_\diamond\le\xi.
}
\tag{4}$$

The approximation is exactly Hermiticity preserving and trace preserving. Complete positivity is not asserted.

The compiler’s worst-case bit work, including the complete schedule, printed supports, local matrices and precision, is

$$\operatorname{poly}_{a,k,d,g,\eta_{\max}}
(n,B,\xi^{-1}).
\tag{5}$$

For the supplied preparation and any finite product POVM, define

$$\widehat p(x)=
\operatorname{Tr}\!\left[
M_x\,\widehat{\mathcal Q}_L(\rho_0)
\right],
\qquad M_x=\bigotimes_i M_i(x_i).$$

Then

$$\sum_x\widehat p(x)=1,
\qquad
\boxed{\sum_x|\widehat p(x)-p(x)|\le\xi.}
\tag{6}$$

The total negative mass of $\widehat p$ is at most $\xi/2$.

1. Exact polymer identity

Let the anchored generators $\mathcal A_i(t)$ be genuine GKLS generators supported on fixed declared balls $B_i$. The declarations must remain fixed across the complete schedule.

For nonempty $X$, let $\mathcal K_X$ sum all Dyson words whose anchor-ball overlap graph is connected and whose declared union is exactly $X$. Absolute convergence of the finite-system Dyson expansion permits regrouping. Disjoint components commute and their ordered integrals combine by the shuffle identity. Consequently,

$$\Phi_V
=
\sum_{\mathcal F\ {\rm disjoint}}
\left(\bigotimes_{X\in\mathcal F}\mathcal K_X\right)
\otimes\operatorname{Id}_{V\setminus\cup\mathcal F}.
\tag{1}$$

Define $Q_L$ by retaining every family whose members all have $|X|\le L$.

For a union $U$, let $\Phi^{\setminus U}$ be the actual evolution generated by those entire anchored generators whose declared balls avoid $U$. It is CPTP on $V\setminus U$.

Then

$$Q_L-\Phi_V
=
\sum_{\substack{\varnothing\ne\mathcal B\ {\rm disjoint}\\
|X|>L\;\forall X\in\mathcal B}}
(-1)^{|\mathcal B|}
\left(\bigotimes_{X\in\mathcal B}\mathcal K_X\right)
\otimes\Phi^{\setminus\cup\mathcal B}.
\tag{2}$$

To verify (2), expand each exterior channel using (1). For any full polymer family $\mathcal F$, its coefficient on the right is

$$\sum_{\varnothing\ne\mathcal B\subseteq\mathcal F_{\rm large}}
(-1)^{|\mathcal B|},$$

which equals $-1$ when $\mathcal F$ contains a large polymer and $0$ otherwise. Those are exactly the coefficients of $Q_L-\Phi_V$.
